opportunities.title: Fulbright All Disciplines Scholar Award

amount.raw: Monthly stipends vary from year to year and are typically enough to comfortably cover the cost of living in the USA

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and other professionals; UK citizens, and non-UK citizens based in and committed to a life and career in the UK who cannot apply through their country of citizenship
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme; grant periods typically 3-6 months

opportunities.title: Fulbright Elon University Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing: private bedroom in The Isley International House at no cost; university support: full-time faculty equivalent

opportunities.summary: Teaching and pursuing independent research in any subject area offered by Elon University

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal College of Surgeons of England Award

amount.raw: £2,275 per month, converted to dollars at the prevailing rate; plus a further grant from the Royal College of Surgeons of England to cover basic NHS Salary costs up to the maximum of the resident doctor pay scale for up to 6 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK trainee Royal College of Surgeons of England members
opportunities.summary: Research into a number of surgical areas at any accredited US higher education institution; scholarship period up to 6 months

opportunities.title: Fulbright Rutgers University-Newark Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing provided within the Honors Living Learning Community; travel grant up to £1,500 for a round trip to the U.S. or equivalent in kind support

opportunities.summary: Teach and pursue research on issues of the contemporary urban environment as part of the Honors Living Learning Community at Rutgers University-Newark; covers one semester of 4 months

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal Society of Edinburgh Scholar Award

amount.raw: Monthly stipends vary from year to year and are typically enough to comfortably cover the cost of living in the USA

opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university

opportunities.title: Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses, settling-in costs, and professional development allowances; round-trip international travel; dependent allowance if applicable

opportunities.summary: Hands-on scientific research supporting the conservation and preservation of cultural and historic artifacts at the National Archives in Maryland; runs minimum 5 months, maximum 12 months, beginning September 2027
